# WolrdPulse — Real-Time DevOps & Cloud Telemetry for AI Agents

> WolrdPulse is an open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides autonomous AI agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf) with real-time global cloud status, edge network latency, DoH DNS queries, and SSL/TLS certificate inspection.

- Website: https://wolrdpulse.app
- Documentation & Features: https://wolrdpulse.app/features
- Developer & Sponsor: https://wolrdpulse.app/developer
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Mealiclay01/wolrdpulse
- Author: Anas Rhimi (https://anasrhimi.tech)
- License: MIT Open Source

## MCP Connection Endpoint
- Server-Sent Events (SSE) URL: `https://wolrdpulse.app/sse`
- JSON-RPC Endpoint: `https://wolrdpulse.app/api/mcp`
- Stdio CLI: `node bin/cli.mjs`

## Core MCP Tools Provided

1. `get_cloud_status`
   - Description: Fetches live operational status and incident reports for AWS, Cloudflare, GitHub, OpenAI, Anthropic, Vercel, Supabase, NPM, and Datadog.
   - Arguments: `provider` (optional string, e.g. "aws", "vercel", "github")

2. `inspect_ssl`
   - Description: Connects via native TLS socket to inspect SSL certificate validity, issuer chain, fingerprint, and remaining days until expiration.
   - Arguments: `domain` (required string, e.g. "api.github.com")

3. `query_dns`
   - Description: Resolves DNS records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, CAA) using Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS (1.1.1.1).
   - Arguments: `domain` (required string), `recordType` (optional string, default "A")

4. `ping_endpoint`
   - Description: Performs synthetic HTTP/HTTPS edge requests to measure TTFB latency, status codes, and headers.
   - Arguments: `url` (required string)

5. `get_tech_pulse`
   - Description: Aggregates latest major open-source releases (Kubernetes, Docker, Bun, Next.js, Rust, Go) and trending repositories.

## Configuration for Claude Desktop & Cursor
Add to your `claude_desktop_config.json` or `cursor_mcp.json`:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "worldpulse": {
      "url": "https://wolrdpulse.app/sse"
    }
  }
}
```
